text: Get main's CI green again. GitHub Actions run 39034450252 (push to main at 39962ed) failed 'athena check --history' with 3 violations: (1) job 20261017-121143-sg0j starts from a state different from where its previous job 20261010-154004-60r4 ended; (2) and (3) the outcome.json of both jobs says landed, but the check says 39962ed is not a valid landing of either. Job 60r4's PR #129 was closed without merging, yet its outcome says landed on branch operator/next4. Find out whether the landing path (two jobs landed together, or a job landed off its own PR) or the history check's landing rule is wrong, and fix that one. Do not edit any existing record. Add a test that reproduces this sequence.
